meta.title: When was that line true, and is it still? | Meditation: Sitting with the Old Note
meta.description:
A fifteen-minute guided meditation for rereading one old note, a remembered limit or a long silence, and giving it its date. You are given pauses, a few plain questions, and a way to hold it gently.

For a Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down and reread, and one old note can be read once and dated.

A slow sitting with one old record, hearing its present tense as the day it was written, so the note is dated rather than discarded or obeyed.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/meditations/meditation-sitting-with-the-old-note

3:47 II
8:36 III

copy.hook: Most old notes speak in the present tense. This sitting adds four words to one of yours, and lets it be old without being wrong.
